# Cholesky Update

![Cholesky Update function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/25-cholesky_update.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Updates an existing upper Cholesky factor using x*x^H: method 0 additive update, 1 subtractive downdate. Invalid downdate reports a warning/error with the retained upper factor according to the provider contract. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: method=0.

</details>
